name: @zealakit/pattern-input-core
description: Internal framework-independent kernel for pattern input fields: state machines, parsers, and prop getters. Private: bundled into each adapter package, never published to npm.
author: nqhed - Huy Ed. Nguyen

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.pure.json --noEmit
scripts.test: pnpm build && node --test tests/*.test.ts tests/shared/*.test.ts tests/lexers/*.test.ts tests/number/*.test.ts tests/masked/*.test.ts tests/otp/*.test.ts tests/controller/*.test.ts
scripts.test:watch: node --test --watch tests/*.test.ts tests/shared/*.test.ts tests/lexers/*.test.ts tests/number/*.test.ts tests/masked/*.test.ts tests/otp/*.test.ts tests/controller/*.test.ts
